args.description: a single heavy ancient Greek bronze axe head with a round hole through the middle of the blade, mounted upright on top of a short plain wooden post planted in a small square stone base, the round hole clearly open so an arrow could pass through it, seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile. Drawn small enough that the stone base and the whole blade are complete and visible. Isolated game asset cut out on a fully transparent background, only the axe and its post. Palette of worn bronze and dark oak. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.
